about: The web app for Lemmy, a link sharing and discussion site that many people run themselves.

prs.title: Links to normal web pages no longer show up as videos or images
prs.broken: The app guessed a link was a video or image if a file ending appeared anywhere in it. A news page on webmd.com showed a video player because "webm" was in the site name.
prs.changed: A link now counts as a video, image or audio only when the file ending is at the very end of the address.
prs.matters: Posts that link to articles show as links, not broken players.
